findings.summary: The note-id regex in the test accepts only [A-Za-z0-9]+ id prefixes; a future restart-required setting with a non-alphanumeric page element id would make the guard fail rather than silently pass.
findings.detail: TheStaticPageCarriesExactlyTheRestartRequiredNotes extracts ids with Regex id="([A-Za-z0-9]+)RestartNote". All seven current restart-required page element ids are alphanumeric (verified against RestartRequiredSettings and the served markup), so the guard is exact for the current set. If a future classification entry used a hyphen/underscore page element id, the extracted set would omit it and the Assert.Equal against the classification-derived expected set would fail (fail-safe, not a false pass). This is a test-maintenance note, not a correctness issue for this task.
